name: Commercial Metals
outlook:
What Commercial Metals says to expect

  • First quarter fiscal 2027: North America Steel GroupFor the North America Steel Group, improved pricing is expected to largely offset higher scrap costs, startup expenses, and a slight seasonal decline in shipments, resulting in adjusted EBITDA that is expected to be nearly flat in comparison to the fourth quarter.
  • First quarter fiscal 2027: Construction Solutions GroupWithin the Construction Solutions Group, adjusted EBITDA is expected to be down sequentially reflecting typical seasonal trends impacting the end market activity of this segment.
  • First quarter fiscal 2027: Europe Steel GroupMeaningful sequential growth in adjusted EBITDA is anticipated for the Europe Steel Group with the first quarter benefiting from improving operating conditions and a CO 2 credit.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 15, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
